input.plan:
# Story filters via SQL templates

## Decisions (locked)

- Options: always `SELECT DISTINCT` from `filter.table` + `filter.column` (table required).
- Filter types in v1: `select`, `multi_select`, `search`, `date_range` (no `number_range`).
- No in-place edit of existing tool SQL — the agent rewrites queries (new `execute_sql` + update story `query_id`s) when adding filters.
- No sqlglot rewrite from `stash@{1}`; templates only. Reuse ideas from [prior filter UI work](d4c11f70-81cf-478b-883d-d97000745f71) for `<filter>` parsing / bar UI.
- `story_data_cache` / chat tool outputs stay the **unfiltered** baseline (templates stripped). Active filter selections always re-query and are not written to cache.

## Mental model

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  storyCode["story_version.code\nfilter + chart tags"]
  toolSql["execute_sql toolInput.sql_query\nwith filter templates"]
  bar["StoryFilterBar selections"]
  render["renderSqlTemplate"]
  exec["FastAPI execute_sql"]
  embeds["Charts / tables"]

  storyCode --> bar
  bar --> render
  toolSql --> render
  render --> exec --> embeds
  storyCode --> embeds
```

Authoring example:

```sql
SELECT SUM(revenue) AS revenue, country
FROM orders
WHERE 1 = 1
{% filter country %} AND country IN ({{ filters.country.sql }}) {% endfilter %}
{% filter q %} AND customer_name ILIKE {{ filters.q.sql }} {% endfilter %}
{% filter period %} AND order_date BETWEEN {{ filters.period.sql }} {% endfilter %}
GROUP BY country
```

```html
<filter id="country" column="country" label="Country" type="multi_select" table="orders" />
<filter id="q" column="customer_name" label="Customer" type="search" table="orders" />
<filter id="period" column="order_date" label="Period" type="date_range" table="orders" />
<chart query_id="query_abc12345" ... />
```

Binding is by **filter id** in the SQL template. A query is affected only if it contains `{% filter <id> %}…{% endfilter %}`. No `charts=` attribute in v1.

## SQL template engine

Add [`apps/shared/src/sql-template.ts`](apps/shared/src/sql-template.ts) (+ tests):

1. **Strip mode** (chat + live cache refresh + default story load): remove every `{% filter id %}…{% endfilter %}` block (non-greedy, case-sensitive ids). Result must be valid runnable SQL (`WHERE 1 = 1` pattern).
2. **Render mode** (story with active filters): for each block, if that filter has an active value, keep inner SQL and replace `{{ filters.<id>.sql }}` with a **type-aware escaped literal fragment**; if inactive/empty, drop the whole block.
3. **`.sql` rendering** (only safe surface — no raw interpolation):
   - `select` → `'US'`
   - `multi_select` → `'US', 'FR'`
   - `search` → `'%term%'` (escape `%`/`_` in user input after quoting rules)
   - `date_range` → `'2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31'` (omit block unless both ends set)
4. Escape strings by doubling single quotes. Reject values containing null bytes. Unknown placeholders / malformed blocks → clear error.

Wire strip into:

- [`apps/backend/src/agents/tools/execute-sql.ts`](apps/backend/src/agents/tools/execute-sql.ts) before FastAPI / app-db execution and before read-only checks on the effective SQL
- [`apps/backend/src/services/live-story.ts`](apps/backend/src/services/live-story.ts) `executeLiveQuery` / `refreshStoryData` so cache stays unfiltered

## `<filter>` tag (shared + agent docs)

Extend [`apps/shared/src/story-segments.ts`](apps/shared/src/story-segments.ts), [`chart-block.ts`](apps/shared/src/chart-block.ts), [`story-validation.ts`](apps/shared/src/story-validation.ts):

- Types: `select | multi_select | search | date_range`
- Required attrs: `id`, `column`, `type`, `table`
- Optional: `label` (default `column`)
- Unique ids; self-closing; validate type enum
- Soft validation (warning-level or story-tool guidance): every `<filter id>` should be referenced by some story query SQL template, and vice versa when possible at create time

Document in [`apps/backend/src/agents/tools/story.ts`](apps/backend/src/agents/tools/story.ts) and `execute_sql` description: how to write templates, that chat strips blocks, and that adding filters means **rewriting** SQL via a new `execute_sql` then pointing charts at the new `query_id`.

## Backend APIs

In [`story.routes.ts`](apps/backend/src/trpc/story.routes.ts) and [`shared-story.routes.ts`](apps/backend/src/trpc/shared-story.routes.ts):

| Procedure | Behavior |
|-----------|----------|
| `getFilterOptions` | Input: story identity + filter id. Resolve filter from latest code → run `SELECT DISTINCT <column> FROM <table> LIMIT 100` (quoted identifiers carefully / pass through warehouse as agent-authored table name). Return string options. |
| `getFilteredQueryData` | Input: story identity + `selections: Record<filterId, string \| string[]>`. Load all SQL for chart/table `query_id`s in the story, `renderSqlTemplate` each, execute in parallel, return `QueryDataMap`. Queries with no matching active template blocks behave like stripped baseline. |

Keep implementation in a small service e.g. [`apps/backend/src/services/story-filters.ts`](apps/backend/src/services/story-filters.ts) reusing `executeRawSql` from live-story (extract if needed).

Do **not** persist filtered maps into `story_data_cache`.

## Frontend

- [`story-filter-bar.tsx`](apps/frontend/src/components/story-filter-bar.tsx): controls for the four types; options via `getFilterOptions` when `table` present; Clear action.
- Hook/context [`use-story-filters.ts`](apps/frontend/src/hooks/use-story-filters.ts) (or thin context): hold selections (URL query `story_filter_<id>` for shareable state, same idea as stash), debounce, call `getFilteredQueryData` when any selection active; otherwise use baseline `queryData`.
- Mount bar in [`story-preview.tsx`](apps/frontend/src/components/side-panel/story-preview.tsx) + [`story-tabbed-content.tsx`](apps/frontend/src/components/story-tabbed-content.tsx); pass effective data into embeds on preview / standalone / shared / preview routes.
- Filter segments are **not** rendered inline in `SegmentList` — only via the top bar.
- TipTap rich-editor node for filters is **out of scope** for v1 (raw tag in code view / markdown is fine).

## Out of scope

- Editing stored `execute_sql` tool inputs in place
- sqlglot / automatic WHERE pushdown
- `number_range`
- Writing filtered results into `story_data_cache`
- PDF/HTML export reflecting active UI filters (export keeps stripped/baseline SQL)

## Test plan

- Unit tests for strip/render/escaping across all four types and nested-looking SQL
- Story validation tests for `<filter>` attrs
- Backend test: templated SQL strips in execute path; filtered render produces expected SQL string before execute (mock FastAPI)
- Lint: `npm run lint`
